sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We welcome your commitment to a 24-month contract and the 14-day payment terms, which we have adopted in our proposal.
For a 24-month term, we must apply the AS-14404 index clause, as we cannot offer fixed pricing over this duration.
While company policy prevents us from sharing a detailed cost breakdown, we can offer a revised price of €5.60 per unit in return for the faster payment and extended contract.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We thank you for your revised offer and are pleased to accept the 14-day payment terms.
Please note that we cannot offer a fixed price over a 24-month period, making the AS-14404 index clause mandatory.
With this clause and the faster payment, we can reduce our price to €5.50 per unit; additionally, please provide the data supporting your volume commitment of 23,700 pieces.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
